name: ceramics-api

dependencies.name: ceramics-db
dependencies.description: Relational store for products, variants, accounts, addresses, carts, orders, order items, and audit log entries.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Shared sign-in for customers and staff; roles are resolved from the caller's group claim (Customer vs Store Admin).

dependencies.name: payment-provider
dependencies.description: Creates/confirms payment intents during checkout; never stores raw card data.

config.description: Stripe secret API key used to create/confirm payment intents.
Signing secret to verify Stripe webhook callbacks.

dependencies.name: email-provider
dependencies.description: Sends order confirmation emails to customers after successful checkout.

description: Go service owning the ceramics store's catalog, cart, checkout, order, and admin management APIs, plus all persistence in ceramics-db. Listens on :9090, exposes GET /health. Authenticates end users via the shared user-auth Thunder dependency; resolves Customer vs Store Admin/Staff role from the caller's group claim. Delegates payment processing to payment-provider and order-confirmation email to email-provider. Does not issue its own tokens and does not validate JWTs itself (the gateway does).
